name: A Complex Story
source:
In this narrative Point'n Click, you take on the role of Olivia, a teenager searching for her brother, who'd been kidnapped by an unidentified organization. Scour the facility and find your way out alongside Lisa, a strange prisoner whose sole aim is to escape.

[translated from [url=https://asahiislate.itch.io/a-complex-story]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
在这款叙事点击式游戏中，你将扮演少女Olivia，寻找被不明组织绑架的兄弟。搜遍设施，与一位满心只想逃脱的古怪囚犯Lisa一起，寻找离开的路。

[译自[url=https://asahiislate.itch.io/a-complex-story]itch.io[/url]]
